raw: {"diagnosis": "LVH", "stemi": "no", "rationale": "Sinus rhythm with very deep S waves in V1-V3 (S V3 about 24 mm plus R aVL about 7 mm gives Cornell about 31 mm), and lateral T-wave inversion in I and aVL fits a strain pattern; the ST elevation in V1-V3 is small compared with the large S waves and points the opposite way to the QRS, as expected with LVH, so it does not meet STEMI criteria."}

parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm with very deep S waves in V1-V3 (S V3 about 24 mm plus R aVL about 7 mm gives Cornell about 31 mm), and lateral T-wave inversion in I and aVL fits a strain pattern; the ST elevation in V1-V3 is small compared with the large S waves and points the opposite way to the QRS, as expected with LVH, so it does not meet STEMI criteria.
